# REET Rajasthan Composite Examination Master Blueprint & All-Subject Strategy

## 1. Conducting Authority & Examination Structure
- **Conducting Body**: Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan (RBSE / BSER), Ajmer (माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड राजस्थान, अजमेर).
- **Examination Level**: REET Level 1 (Classes I to V / Primary) & REET Level 2 (Classes VI to VIII / Upper Primary).
- **Structure**: 150 Multiple Choice Questions, 150 Marks, 150 Minutes duration.
- **Marking Scheme**: +1.0 mark per correct answer; **0.0 negative marking** for eligibility.
- **Qualifying Cut-off**: 60% (90/150 marks) for General category; 55% (82/150 marks) for OBC/SC/ST in TSP and Non-TSP regions as per state norms.
- **Certificate Validity**: Lifetime validity across Rajasthan for eligibility towards 3rd Grade Teacher (तृतीय श्रेणी शिक्षक भर्ती परीक्षा - RSMSSB).

## 2. Four Core Curriculum Pillars
1. **Child Development & Pedagogy**: Psychological principles of child growth, learning theories, inclusive education, RTE 2009, NEP 2020, and Action Research.
2. **Mathematics, Science & Environmental Studies**: Core numeracy, algebra, geometry, physics, chemistry, biology, ecological balance, and traditional water management.
3. **Languages (Hindi, English & Sanskrit)**: Grammatical morphology, syntax, sandhi, samas, vocabulary, language skills (LSRW), and pedagogical methodologies.
4. **Rajasthan GK, Culture & Educational Scenario**: Physical geography, history, forts, folk deities, arts, and state educational governance (RSCERT, DIET, Shala Darpan).

## 3. Representative Sample of Curated Questions (50% Uniform Sampling)

**Q1 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0001]**
- (EN): According to Section 25 and the Schedule of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 (RTE Act 2009), what is the prescribed Teacher-Pupil Ratio (PTR) for primary schools (Classes I to V) having up to 200 admitted students?
- (HI): निःशुल्क एवं अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार अधिनियम, 2009 (RTE 2009) की धारा 25 एवं अनुसूची के अनुसार 200 तक नामांकित विद्यार्थियों वाले प्राथमिक विद्यालयों (कक्षा 1 से 5) हेतु विहित छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात (Pupil-Teacher Ratio) कितना है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q2 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0002]**
- (EN): According to Jean Piaget's Theory of Cognitive Development, at which stage does a child develop the logical operations of conservation (संरक्षण), reversibility (उत्क्रमणीयता / विलोमियता), and classification?
- (HI): जीन पियाजे के संज्ञानात्मक विकास के सिद्धांत के अनुसार, बालक किस अवस्था में संरक्षण (Conservation), विलोमियता (Reversibility) तथा वर्गीकरण की तार्किक क्षमताओं को अर्जित करता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q3 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0003]**
- (EN): In Lev Vygotsky's Socio-Cultural Theory of Cognitive Development, what term denotes the difference between what a child can achieve independently and what they can achieve with guidance from a More Knowledgeable Other (MKO)?
- (HI): लेव वाइगोत्स्की के सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक विकास सिद्धांत में, बालक द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से किए जा सकने वाले कार्य तथा किसी कुशल वयस्क (MKO) के सहयोग से किए जा सकने वाले कार्य के बीच के अंतर को क्या कहा जाता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q4 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0004]**
- (EN): Who is regarded as the father of Action Research (क्रियात्मक अनुसंधान) in the field of school education, who emphasized that teachers must solve classroom problems scientifically?
- (HI): स्कूली शिक्षा के क्षेत्र में शिक्षकों द्वारा अपनी कक्षागत समस्याओं के वैज्ञानिक समाधान हेतु 'क्रियात्मक अनुसंधान' (Action Research) को स्थापित करने वाले प्रमुख विद्वान कौन हैं?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q5 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0005]**
- (EN): Under Section 21 of the Right to Education Act 2009, what minimum percentage of the total members of the School Management Committee (SMC - विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति) must be parents or guardians of children?
- (HI): RTE अधिनियम 2009 की धारा 21 के अंतर्गत गठित विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) के कुल सदस्यों में से कम से कम कितने प्रतिशत सदस्य बच्चों के माता-पिता अथवा अभिभावक होने अनिवार्य हैं?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q6 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0006]**
- (EN): According to Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences (बहुबुद्धि सिद्धांत), which intelligence type is characterized by the ability to understand other people's moods, feelings, motives, and intentions?
- (HI): हावर्ड गार्डनर के बहुबुद्धि सिद्धांत (Theory of Multiple Intelligences) के अनुसार, अन्य व्यक्तियों की मनोदशा, स्वभाव, प्रेरणाओं तथा आशयों को गहराई से समझने की योग्यता किस बुद्धि के अंतर्गत आती है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q7 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0007]**
- (EN): In Lawrence Kohlberg's Theory of Moral Development, the 'Good Boy - Nice Girl' orientation (अच्छा लड़का - अच्छी लड़की उन्मुखता) belongs to which developmental level?
- (HI): लॉरेंस कोहलबर्ग के नैतिक विकास के सिद्धांत में 'अच्छा लड़का - अच्छी लड़की अनुकूलन' (Good Boy - Nice Girl Orientation) किस स्तर के अंतर्गत आता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q8 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0008]**
- (EN): A child faces persistent severe difficulty in understanding number symbols, performing basic arithmetic operations, memorizing multiplication tables, and calculating change. This specific learning disability is known as:
- (HI): एक बालक को गणितीय संक्रियाओं (जोड़, घटाव, गुणा, भाग), संख्यात्मक प्रतीकों की पहचान, पहाड़े याद करने तथा समय-सारिणी समझने में गंभीर कठिनाई होती है। यह अधिगम अक्षमता कहलाती है:
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0009]**
- (EN): Under Section 25 and Schedule of RTE Act 2009, how many minimum working hours per week (including preparation hours / तैयारी के घंटे सहित) are mandated for a school teacher?
- (HI): RTE अधिनियम 2009 की अनुसूची के अनुसार एक शिक्षक के लिए प्रति सप्ताह तैयारी के घंटों सहित कार्य के न्यूनतम कितने घंटे विहित हैं?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q10 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0010]**
- (EN): In Ivan Pavlov's Classical Conditioning experiment on dogs, what role does the sound of the bell (घंटी की ध्वनि) serve after successful conditioning has been established?
- (HI): इवान पावलव के कुत्ते पर किए गए शास्त्रीय अनुबंधन (Classical Conditioning) प्रयोग में, अनुबंधन स्थापित हो जाने के पश्चात घंटी की ध्वनि किस रूप में कार्य करती है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q11 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0011]**
- (EN): In B.F. Skinner's Operant Conditioning Theory, which reinforcement schedule produces the highest rate of steady responding and the greatest resistance to extinction (जैसे जुआ / स्लॉट मशीन)?
- (HI): बी.एफ. स्किनर के क्रिया प्रसूत अनुबंधन सिद्धांत में, पुनर्बलन की कौन-सी अनुसूची सर्वाधिक उच्च अनुक्रिया दर तथा विलोप के प्रति अधिकतम प्रतिरोध (Resistance to Extinction) उत्पन्न करती है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (EN): The Rorschach Inkblot Test (रोर्शा स्याही धब्बा परीक्षण), developed by Hermann Rorschach in 1921, consists of how many standardized inkblot cards used for projective personality evaluation?
- (HI): स्विस मनोचिकित्सक हरमन रोर्शा द्वारा 1921 में प्रतिपादित रोर्शा स्याही धब्बा परीक्षण (Rorschach Inkblot Test) में व्यक्तित्व के प्रक्षेपी मापन हेतु कुल कितने प्रामाणिक कार्ड होते हैं?

- (HI): राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 (NEP 2020) ने पूर्ववर्ती 10+2 विद्यालयी ढांचे को प्रतिस्थापित कर किस नवीन शैक्षणिक व पाठ्यचर्या संरचना को अंगीकार किया है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q15 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0015]**
- (EN): In Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation (सतत एवं व्यापक मूल्यांकन - CCE), what is the primary diagnostic and pedagogical purpose of 'Assessment for Learning' (अधिगम के लिए आकलन)?
- (HI): सतत एवं व्यापक मूल्यांकन (CCE) में 'अधिगम के लिए आकलन' (Assessment for Learning / रचनात्मक आकलन) का मुख्य शैक्षणिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q16 [reet-child-development-pedagogy | ID: reet-child-development-pedagogy-0016]**
- (EN): Edward Lee Thorndike formulated three primary laws of learning. Which of the following is NOT one of Thorndike's primary laws, but is instead a secondary/subordinate law?
- (HI): एडवर्ड ली थार्नडाइक ने सीखने के तीन मुख्य नियम प्रतिपादित किए। निम्न में से कौन-सा थार्नडाइक का मुख्य नियम न होकर 'गौण नियम' (Secondary Law) है?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

# Child Development, Pedagogy, RTE 2009 & Action Research Comprehensive Guide

## 1. Growth, Development & Learning Theories
- **Heredity & Environment**: Development = Heredity x Environment (Woodworth formula).
- **Developmental Direction**: Cephalocaudal (Head to toe) and Proximodistal (Center outward).
- **Jean Piaget**: 4 Stages - Sensorimotor (0-2), Pre-operational (2-7), Concrete Operational (7-11), Formal Operational (11+).
- **Lev Vygotsky**: Socio-cultural theory, ZPD (Zone of Proximal Development), Scaffolding (पाड़/ढांचा), More Knowledgeable Other (MKO), Private Speech.
- **Lawrence Kohlberg**: 3 Levels, 6 Stages of Moral Development (Pre-conventional, Conventional, Post-conventional).
- **Learning Theorists**: Thorndike (Trial & Error, Law of Effect), Pavlov (Classical Conditioning), Skinner (Operant Conditioning, VR schedule), Kohler (Gestalt Insight).

## 2. Right to Education Act 2009 & NEP 2020
- **RTE 2009 Mandates**: Pupil-Teacher Ratio 30:1 (Primary), 35:1 (Upper Primary); 45 weekly working hours for teachers.
- **SMC (School Management Committee)**: 75% parents/guardians, 50% women members.
- **Section 17**: Complete prohibition of physical punishment and mental harassment.
- **Section 28**: Total ban on private tutoring by school teachers.
- **NEP 2020**: 5+3+3+4 pedagogical structure; mother tongue instruction till Grade 5; NIPUN Bharat FLN mission.
- **Action Research**: Stephen M. Corey; practical scientific problem-solving by teachers for classroom improvement.

# Mathematics, General Science & Environmental Studies Complete Handbook

## 1. Mathematical Formulas & Concepts
- **LCM and HCF**: First Number x Second Number = LCM x HCF.
- **Simple Interest**: SI = (P x R x T) / 100.
- **Geometry**: Area of triangle = 1/2 x Base x Height; Area of circle = π x r^2; Circumference = 2πr.
- **Pedagogy of Mathematics**: Inductive method (Example to rule); Deductive method (Rule to example); Diagnostic testing and remediation.

## 2. General Science Essentials
- **Physics**: Newton's Second Law F = m x a; Radiation does not require material medium; Audible frequency range is 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz.
- **Chemistry**: Rusting is a chemical redox change; pH < 7 is acidic (turns blue litmus red); Sublimation in camphor and dry ice.
- **Biology**: Mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell; Blood Group O- is universal donor, AB+ is universal recipient; Photolysis of water releases oxygen.

## 3. Environmental Studies & Rajasthan Ecology
- **State Symbols**: State Tree Khejri (Prosopis cineraria); State Bird Godawan (Great Indian Bustard); State Animal Chinkara (wild) and Camel (livestock).
- **Traditional Water Harvesting**: Khadin (Paliwal Brahmins, Jaisalmer), Tanka, Johad (Rajendra Singh, Alwar), Chand Baori (Abhaneri, Dausa).
- **Ecology**: 10% energy transfer law by Raymond Lindeman; Desert National Park (Akal Wood Fossil Park); Keoladeo National Park (UNESCO site).

# Trilingual Language Mastery: Hindi, English & Sanskrit Grammar with Pedagogy

## 1. Hindi Grammar & Pedagogy
- **Sandhi**: Guna Sandhi (महा + ऋषि = महर्षि), Yana Sandhi (यदि + अपि = यद्यपि), Vriddhi Sandhi (एक + एक = एकैक).
- **Samas**: Dvigu (चौराहा), Bahuvrihi (दशानन), Karmadharaya (नीलकमल), Tatpurusha (राजपुत्र).
- **Language Skills (LSRW)**: Listening -> Speaking -> Reading -> Writing (सुबोपलि).
- **Remedial Teaching**: Identifying errors via diagnostic tests and eliminating misconceptions through targeted pedagogy.

## 2. English Grammar & Pedagogy
- **Concord**: Neither... nor agrees with nearest subject; Collective nouns take singular verbs for cohesive groups.
- **Voice & Speech**: Simple past active transforms into 'was/were + V3'; Universal scientific facts maintain present tense in indirect speech.
- **Teaching Methods**: Communicative Language Teaching (CLT) emphasizes communicative competence; Bilingual Method (C.J. Dodson) permits teacher-only mother tongue use.

## 3. Sanskrit Grammar & Pedagogy
- **Maheshwara Sutrani**: 14 Sutras revealed by Lord Shiva's Damaru forming the basis of Pratyaharas (Ak, Ach, Hal).
- **Sutras**: 'येनाङ्गविकारः' mandates Tritiya Vibhakti (पादेन खञ्जः); 'क्तक्तवतू निष्ठा' for past tense participle.
- **Methods**: Bhandarkar Method (Grammar-Translation by Dr. R.G. Bhandarkar); Pathshala Gurukula Vidhi.

- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [reet-languages-hindi-english-sanskrit | ID: reet-languages-hindi-english-sanskrit-0009]**
- (EN): According to Paninian grammar, which Vibhakti (case ending) is prescribed by the Sutra 'येनाङ्गविकारः' (Yenangavikarah) when indicating a bodily defect or deformity?
- (HI): पाणिनीय संस्कृत व्याकरण के सूत्र 'येनाङ्गविकारः' के अनुसार शरीर के जिस अंग में विकार या विकृति लक्षित होती है, उस विकृत अंगवाचक शब्द में कौन-सी विभक्ति प्रयुक्त होती है?

**Q10 [reet-languages-hindi-english-sanskrit | ID: reet-languages-hindi-english-sanskrit-0010]**

# Rajasthan History, Art, Culture, Geography & Educational Scenario Complete Repository

## 1. Physical Geography of Rajasthan
- **Physiographic Zones**: Thar Desert (61.11% area, 40% pop), Aravalli Range (Guru Shikhar 1722m), Eastern Plains, Hadoti Plateau.
- **Rivers**: Luni (Sweet till Balotra, saline after), Chambal (Perennial, ravine badlands), Banas (Longest entirely within Rajasthan), Mahi (Cuts Tropic of Cancer twice).
- **Lakes**: Sambhar Salt Lake (Produces ~8.7% of India's salt, Ramsar site), Jaisamand (Dhebar artificial freshwater lake).

## 2. History & Folk Heritage of Rajasthan
- **Civilizations**: Kalibangan (Ploughed field, fire altars), Ahar (Tamravati Nagari), Ganeshwar (Mother of copper cultures).
- **Historical Milestones**: Battle of Haldighati (18 June 1576); Bijolia Movement (44 years, Vijay Singh Pathik); Mangarh Massacre (17 Nov 1913, Govind Giri).
- **Integration**: 7 stages starting with Matsya Union on 18 March 1948 to Present Rajasthan on 1 Nov 1956 (Rajasthan Day on 30 March).
- **Art & Architecture**: UNESCO 6 Hill Forts (Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh 36-km wall, Ranthambore, Amber, Jaisalmer, Gagron Water Fort); Kishangarh 'Bani Thani' (Mona Lisa of India); Kalbelia Dance (UNESCO 2010).
- **Folk Deities**: Panchpir (Ramdevji, Pabuji, Gogaji, Mehaji, Harbhuji); Tejaji Maharaj; Beneshwar Dham Tribal Kumbh.

## 3. Educational Scenario of Rajasthan (शैक्षिक परिदृश्य)
- **RSCERT Udaipur**: Established 11 Nov 1978 on Mehrotra Committee recommendations; apex academic authority for curriculum and textbooks.
- **DIET**: District-level nodal institute for teacher training and Class 5 & 8 board examinations.
- **ICT Innovations**: Shala Darpan centralized portal (launched 2015); SMILE Program (April 2020 WhatsApp e-content); DIKSHA-RISE.
- **Flagship Welfare**: Mahatma Gandhi Government Schools (MGGS - English Medium, 2019); Mukhyamantri Bal Gopal Yojana (nutritious milk for Classes 1-8).
